facts.fact: Founded in 1808, the botanical garden contains themed collections and greenhouses.
Listed collections include orchids, bromeliads, ferns and a Japanese garden.
The tourism office lists visitor access on Rua Jardim Botânico.

title: Riotur — Jardim Botânico
